name: Sales register — outward supply invoice-level
notes: Primary source for all output tax sections. Line-item level mandatory.

name: Credit note and debit note register
notes: Must carry original invoice number. Unlinked CNs are an immediate finding.

name: Purchase register — inward supply invoice-level
notes: Write path retired 2026-08-10 (TYPED-TABLES-PLAN.md 10 step 4) — promotes via purchase_register (tenant 010) and src/silver/registers, not transaction_document, per an explicit guard in src/silver/promote.py. archetype stays 1: it is mandatory classification data whenever in_scope (document_type_scope_ck, shared 003), not a write-path switch. GL code and cost centre mandatory for Rule 42 pool segregation.

name: Advance receipt register
notes: Required for all service taxpayers.

name: Unbilled revenue schedule
notes: date_of_service_completion is the critical field. Without it the 30-day rule is flag-only.

name: Job work dispatch register
notes: Dispatch date triggers the 1-year/3-year statutory return deadline.

name: Running account / continuous supply contract register
notes: Section 12(4) continuous supply timing check. Contract terms extracted.

name: Audited Profit and Loss Account
notes: Starting point for GSTR-9C Table 5 turnover bridge.

name: Trial balance — GL-level detail
notes: Maps each GL to GST treatment. Required for Rule 42 pool segregation.

name: Balance sheet — full year
notes: Multiple uses across output and input tax sections.

name: Fixed asset register — asset-level
notes: Rule 44 disposal reversal cannot be computed from aggregate totals.

name: Creditor ageing report
notes: ADR-006 gap. Primary input for 180-day payment rule.

name: Payment register — supplier payments
notes: Bank transfer date is the payment date. Cheque issue date is not.

name: Bank statements — outward payments to suppliers
notes: ADR-006 gap. Authoritative record of payment dates for the 180-day rule.

name: Bank statements — inward foreign currency receipts
notes: ADR-006 gap. Supports FIRC/BRC reconciliation.

name: Stock / inventory register
notes: Section 17(5)(h) write-off ITC reversal.

name: Product / SKU master with MRP flag
notes: ADR-006 gap. Cannot be derived from the invoice register.

name: Inter-GSTIN transaction register
notes: Required for multi-GSTIN entities. Traverses entities within one tenant.

name: Cost allocation register — HO to branch
notes: Allocations without invoice may constitute taxable inter-GSTIN supplies.

name: Platform settlement reports — MTR/GTR/SSR/DRR/VRET
notes: DUPLICATE — same documents as D1.01-07. Canonical row is D1.*; this ref is an alias. Stream C not B — the operator is authoritative not the client.

name: ITC reversal register — Rule 42/43 and s.17(5)
notes: Cross-checked against GSTR-3B declarations.

name: RCM register
notes: Particularly important for import of services.

name: Foreign currency payment register
notes: ADR-006 gap. Completeness gate — if absent ALL import-of-services checks are INCOMPLETE.

name: Common input service invoices at HO
notes: Required for ISD distribution verification post 01 Oct 2023.

name: Certificate of Incorporation with CIN
notes: ADR-006 gap. CIN is the anchor for MCA registry cross-checks.

name: Memorandum and Articles of Association
notes: Establishes authorised business scope.

name: Shareholding pattern — per year in scope
notes: ADR-006 gap. Identifies 25%+ holders — triggers s.15 related person test. Must be period-specific.

name: Related party register
notes: ADR-006 gap. Cannot be derived from transaction data. Without it ALL A6 checks are INCOMPLETE.

name: Ind AS 24 / AS-18 related party disclosure
notes: ADR-006 gap. Auditor-verified related party list. Per year in scope.

name: Joint venture agreement
notes: s.15 related person test — both controlling a third person.

name: GSTIN register — all GSTINs under the PAN
notes: ADR-006 gap. Missing GSTINs mean incomplete inter-GSTIN reconciliation.

name: List of directors with DIN
notes: ADR-006 gap. Required for RCM determination and related party identification.

name: Form DIR-12 — director appointment and cessation
notes: Establishes periods of directorship for period-specific RCM.

name: Board resolution appointing whole-time / managing director
notes: Without this the default assumption is non-executive — RCM at 18%.

name: Director service agreement / employment contract
notes: Establishes employer-employee relationship for Schedule III exclusion.

name: Payroll and TDS register
notes: TDS code is the primary determinant of employee vs contractor.

name: Key managerial personnel list
notes: Verifiable against MCA filings.

name: Cost-sharing agreements
notes: Circular 159/15/2021 requires documented evidence of cost-sharing basis.

name: Service contracts with foreign customers
notes: Five-condition test under s.2(6) IGST Act.

name: Overseas vendor contracts
notes: Import of services RCM identification.

name: Job work agreement
notes: Distinguishes job work from contract manufacturing.

name: Long-duration service contracts
notes: Time of supply on milestone and POCM revenue recognition.

name: Transfer pricing documentation
notes: Most defensible open market value basis under s.15(4) Rule 28.

name: Advance Pricing Agreement
notes: Higher evidentiary value than TP study — government-agreed price.

name: GTA invoices and consignment notes
notes: Consignment note is the trigger document for GTA RCM.

name: Security agency contracts
notes: Supplier entity type determines forward charge vs RCM.

name: Letter of Undertaking — ARN GSTIN financial year
notes: ADR-006 gap. The instrument all export zero-rating rests on. Must be valid at each export invoice date.

name: Importer Exporter Code certificate
notes: Must be linked to the exporting GSTIN.

name: SEZ unit Letter of Approval
notes: LoA validity at supply date is a hard condition for zero-rating.

name: SEZ unit Letter of Permission — IT/ITES
notes: Same function as LoA for service SEZ units.

name: SEZ Operations Commencement Certificate
notes: Entitlement begins from commencement date not LoA date.

name: SEZ Notification — boundaries and approved units
notes: Establishes the recipient premises are within a notified SEZ.

name: SEZ Annual Performance Report
notes: Rejected APR loses zero-rated entitlement from suspension date.

name: EOU Letter of Permission with NFE obligation
notes: NFE obligation status determines continued EOU eligibility.

name: STPI registration letter
notes: Required for suppliers to STPI units claiming zero-rated status.

name: EOU Annual Compliance Report
notes: Non-compliance can cause retrospective demand on zero-rated supplies.

name: EPCG Licence
notes: Deemed export claim under Notification 48/2017. Licence number must appear on invoice.

name: Advance Authorisation licence
notes: Permitted inputs list must cover the goods supplied.

name: Export Obligation Discharge Certificate
notes: Without EODC the deemed export entitlement remains contingent.

name: FIRC / BRC register — realisation per export invoice
notes: 12-month realisation deadline monitoring. Register form; instruments are D2.01/D2.02.

name: SOFTEX form approval
notes: STPI equivalent of shipping bill for software exports.

name: Customs Bonded Warehouse licence
notes: Zero-rating to EOU is anchored to the bonded premises.

name: ITC-04 acknowledgements
notes: Defence against deemed supply on job-work deadline expiry.

name: Bill of Entry — assessed and out-of-charge copy
notes: Assessed BoE establishes customs value and HSN for IGST ITC. See also B5.03.

name: Customs Tariff Classification / speaking order
notes: Entity-specific ruling OVERRIDES the general HSN master for this taxpayer.

name: Customs Duty Exemption Certificate
notes: Notification applicability and entity entitlement both required.

name: B-17 Bond — EOU customs bond
notes: Breach can retrospectively affect zero-rating of related supplies.

name: Bond with Letter of Undertaking — customs
notes: Export entitlement instrument for customs.

name: Authorised Economic Operator certificate
notes: Certificate validity must be current.

name: RBI approval for delayed export realisation
notes: Without it IGST becomes payable with interest from export date.

name: RBI Compounding Order
notes: Establishes the settled position on a FEMA violation.

name: Overseas Direct Investment approval
notes: Establishes related party relationship with overseas subsidiary.

name: Form 15CA / 15CB remittance certificates
notes: 15CB classification determines RCM applicability and treaty position.

name: SCOMET licence
notes: Required where the taxpayer exports SCOMET items.

name: GSTR-1 — all periods all tables
notes: Government record of declared outward supply. Raw API response retained in Bronze per ADR-002.

name: GSTR-1 ARN and filing date
notes: Delayed filings trigger interest computation from due date.

name: GSTR-2B — auto-populated ITC statement
notes: Authoritative ITC availability. Cap on claimable ITC post s.16(2)(aa).

name: GSTR-2B amendment history
notes: Supplier amendments affect ITC already claimed in prior periods.

name: GSTR-3B — all periods
notes: What was declared and paid.

name: GSTR-9 Annual Return
notes: Formal reconciliation target for turnover and ITC.

name: GSTR-9C Reconciliation Statement
notes: Platform computes the bridge independently and compares.

name: GSTR-2A — historical pre-2020
notes: Forensic engagements covering pre-GSTR-2B periods.

name: GSTR-6 / GSTR-6A — ISD return
notes: Required for clients operating as ISD.

name: GSTR-7 — TDS by specified persons
notes: TDS deducted reduces net tax payable.

name: GSTR-8 — TCS by e-commerce operators
notes: Primary check for marketplace seller TCS reconciliation.

name: GST Registration Certificate REG-06 — own GSTINs
notes: Foundational identity document. Registration type determines ITC eligibility.

name: GST Registration Certificate — key customers
notes: Supply to composition dealer cannot carry ITC to buyer.

name: GST Registration Certificate — key suppliers
notes: Cancellation at invoice date voids ITC.

name: GST Registration amendment history
notes: Registration type changes affect ITC eligibility.

name: Composition opt-in CMP-01 and opt-out CMP-04
notes: During composition periods the taxpayer cannot issue tax invoices.

name: ISD Registration Certificate
notes: Without ISD registration branch ITC claims via cross-charge are invalid.

name: GSTIN active/cancelled/suspended status at date
notes: Active status at date of supply is the test — not current status.

name: Open Show Cause Notice register
notes: ADR-006 gap. Platform must not re-flag an issue already subject to an SCN.

name: DRC-01B notices — GSTR-1 vs 3B mismatch
notes: System-generated notices. Must be reconciled and responded to.

name: DRC-03 voluntary payment records
notes: ADR-006 gap. Critical in Forensic Mode to avoid double-counting payments already made.

name: Amnesty scheme participation certificate / settlement order
notes: DUPLICATE — same document as D5.07. Platform must not re-raise settled issues.

name: Court order / stay order specific to the taxpayer
notes: DUPLICATE — same document as D5.06. Stayed demands excluded from open anomaly count.

name: Personal hearing and adjudication orders
notes: Establishes the current stage of proceedings.

name: Refund applications RFD-01 and status
notes: 60-day processing deadline monitoring.

name: IRN / IRP register
notes: IRP timestamp is the authoritative invoice date.

name: E-Way Bill outward register
notes: Three-way match with invoice and GSTR-1.

name: E-Way Bill threshold history
notes: OUT OF SCOPE — platform reference data not tenant data. Belongs in inafin-gst-corpus. Bitemporal.

name: E-invoice threshold history
notes: OUT OF SCOPE — platform reference data not tenant data. Belongs in inafin-gst-corpus. Bitemporal.

name: ICEGATE shipping bill data
notes: Three-way match with sales invoice and GSTR-1 Table 6A.

name: ICEGATE EGM status per shipping bill
notes: Refund cannot be processed until EGM is filed by the shipping line.

name: Bill of Entry data from ICEGATE
notes: Separate from GSTR-2B — flows from ICEGATE not supplier GSTR-1. See also A6.01.

name: DGFT eBRC
notes: Government-authenticated. Distinct from bank-issued FIRC (D2.01).

name: IEC registry — number linked GSTIN validity
notes: IEC-GSTIN mismatch blocks refund processing.

name: Export obligation status per EPCG/AA licence
notes: Defaulted obligation retroactively affects deemed export claims.

name: Amazon Monthly Tax Report
notes: Canonical row for A1.20 alias. Primary source for Amazon seller GSTR-1 preparation.

name: Flipkart GST Tax Report
notes: Field mapping differs from Amazon — held as operator configuration.

name: Seller Settlement Report
notes: Settlement cycle does not align with the GST monthly period.

name: Disbursement / Remittance Report
notes: Bank receipts + TCS + fees must equal gross platform sales.

name: VRET / CCOGS return report
notes: Every return must have a corresponding credit note.

name: Swiggy / Zomato restaurant partner order report
notes: Post 01 Jan 2022 restaurant app sales are nil-rated. Circular 167/2021.

name: Other marketplace settlement reports
notes: Meesho Myntra Nykaa Snapdeal. Field mapping as configuration.

name: Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate
notes: Bank-issued. Distinct from DGFT eBRC (B6.01). Register form is A5.14.

name: Bank Realisation Certificate — pre-eBRC
notes: Forensic engagements covering pre-eBRC periods.

name: SEZ Bill of Entry — goods receipt at SEZ gate
notes: Absence means goods did not enter the SEZ — zero-rating disqualified.

name: SEZ inter-unit supply permissions
notes: Without permission the supply may not qualify for zero-rated treatment.

name: MCA21 registry data — DIR-12 MGT-7
notes: Verifiable source for director history and shareholding pattern.

name: NCLT admission order — IBC moratorium
notes: Establishes moratorium date. 180-day payment rule exception.

name: IBC resolution plan
notes: Determines ITC recovery position post-resolution.

name: Advance Ruling obtained by the taxpayer
notes: DUPLICATE — register lists this as C4.03 and D5.01 and states C4.03 is stored in D5. OVERRIDES corpus position for this taxpayer.

name: Entity-specific targeted exemption instrument
notes: Two-part check — corpus notification C2.05 AND this instrument. BOTH required.

name: Entity-specific CBIC / jurisdictional officer clarification
notes: Not published. A defence instrument even if the general position later changed.

name: Investment incentive scheme approval
notes: Scheme notification + individual approval + compliance conditions all required.

name: GST Practitioner authorisation PCT-05
notes: Establishes scope of authorised portal access. Relevant to the CA firm engagement model.

name: Court / stay order specific to the taxpayer
notes: DUPLICATE — canonical row is B3.05.

name: GST amnesty / settlement scheme certificate
notes: DUPLICATE — canonical row is B3.04.
